as_told.title: Tim Taylor carries credentials from multiple intelligence agencies

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a man named Timothy Taylor, who is linked to NASA and to talk of a possible secret space program. Michels says that, according to Diana Pasulka, a professor who writes about UFO belief, Taylor showed her credentials from several US intelligence agencies. A commentator who goes by UAPGerb says much the same but does not credit Pasulka, and he names access to the NRO, the National Reconnaissance Office, the agency that runs America's spy satellites. If true, it would suggest someone with deep government ties is involved in the subject.
